snippet.title: Spook-A-Boo - Official Developer Overview Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at the Developer Overview Trailer for Spook-A-Boo, an adventure co-op ghost hunting game developed by Wala Interactive. Players will detect, scan, and trap ghosts alone or with friends in co-op. Spook-A-Boo is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
